security_problem: SECURITY INVARIANT: server_received(C) => durable_commit(C), where a full hash-linked terminal allow record reaches the configured ledger before relay. SUPPORTED MODEL: single process/writer; one regular O_SYNC ledger; stable configured pathname with every component non-symlink; no online rotation/rebinding. ATTACK CLASSES: write failure, short write, closed/non-regular sink, path disappearance/inode change, symlink substitution in any component, crash before directory/record durability, poisoned logger, restart with valid/corrupt chain. FAILURE SEMANTICS: anything uncertain denies with zero relay. NON-GOALS: continued service during online rotation/rebinding, automatic reopen, symlink ledger, symlinked ancestors, multi-writer ledger, distributed audit.
required_behavior: durable_commit(C) is the sole terminal-allow commit point. The constructor-bound regular O_SYNC ledger, symlink-free binding, directory durability, full write, and chain transition must validate before relay. Chain state, metrics, and taint advance only after success. Valid restart state recovers from the exact append descriptor; corrupt/incomplete recovery and every sink/write/durability/binding/poison uncertainty deny with zero relay and no allowed-state mutation. Supported-model violations are rejected, not repaired online.
failure_behavior: Fail closed: write failure, short write, closed or non-regular sink, poisoned logger, missing/rotated/rebound configured audit path (including any symlink in a path component), crash before directory or record durability, and corrupt or incomplete restart chain deny the valid tools/call with zero relay, no allowed-state mutation, and no later write after poison.

attack_classes.expected: write failure, short write, closed sink, or crash before record durability denies with zero relay and poisons the logger
closed or non-regular sink denies with zero relay and poisons the logger

path disappearance, inode change, symlink substitution in any component (final and ancestor symlinks share this class), or crash before directory durability denies with zero relay and poisons the logger
no later write after any poison source
valid restart recovers from the exact append descriptor; corrupt or incomplete restart denies with zero relay
